diagnosis.compiler_defect: The stale packaged probe compiler lowered authenticated SLTIU at 0x00001A38 as ReservedInstruction, changing Cause from 0x20 to 0x28 and falsely entering A0/0x40. Rebuilding the current compiler preserves SLTIU and the original syscall exception path.
diagnosis.media_identity_defect: DiscSource previously omitted the authenticated sector-4 SCEE identity; fixed by media-derived GetID binding.
diagnosis.path_defect: 0x80030000 is copied BIOS shell code rather than game code; the shell must execute before CD commands can occur.
